honesty.access: anonymous only; no credential is entered, stored, or synthesized, so no premium payload can enter these artifacts
honesty.authority: this harness measures and screenshots; it scores, ranks, and judges nothing
honesty.capture_method: NOT a live `/stocks/MSFT.html` site route capture. The real `engine.security_state.compile_security_state_failure` (owner_read_completed=False, the M1 shell) and the real committed golden MSFT fixture were each passed through `scripts.build_ticker_pages.build_security_state()` and rendered through `templates/ticker.html.j2`. The Identity checks `.dpanel` was extracted from `#dlg-ss-evidence` `.dsr-dlg-body` into a standalone harness with the template's inline `<style>` and `templates/theme.css`, no other page chrome. Both panels are stacked on one harness page.
honesty.gaps: states that were not captured are recorded with a reason; nothing is inferred for them
honesty.light_theme_judgment: Judged as a design, not a token swap: light renders a white/near-white cool canvas, hairline 1px dividers between R1..R9 receipts, and dark ink text — a materially different surface from dark's luminance-depth panel.
